description: **Core mechanic** : every spell you cast costs {1} less per target — Hinata turns multi-target spells into budget bombs.
**Engine** : cast 36 instants/sorceries with token-makers (Young Pyromancer, Talrand, Murmuring Mystic, Deekah) and draw engines (Whirlwind of Thought) converting each spell into value.
**Payoff** : Guttersnipe and Zaffai ping the table with every spell; Metallurgic Summonings and Sunbird's Invocation add free spells.
win: **Token swarm** : Talrand/Young Pyromancer/Murmuring Mystic + Launch the Fleet / Smoke Spirits' Aid make a wide flying board.
**X-burn** : Comet Storm / Jaya's Immolating Inferno deal lethal damage split across the table.
**Recursion** : Radiant Scrollwielder / Mystic Retrieval / Reconstruct History replay the winning spells.

feature.name: Infinite mana permanents you control can produce
Tap all permanents your opponents control each upkeep

combos.notablePrerequisites: Permanents you control can tap to produce at least {3}{U/R}{U/R}{U}{U}.
combos.description:
Activate any number of mana-producing permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U/R}{U/R}{U}{U}.
Activate Soulfire Grand Master by paying {2}{U/R}{U/R}, causing you to put the next instant or sorcery card you cast from your hand this turn into your hand as it resolves.
Cast Reality Spasm by paying a total of {U}{U} due to Hinata, untapping the mana-producing permanents and returning Reality Spasm to your hand due to Soulfire Grand Master.
Repeat.
You may also repeat this on each opponent's upkeep to first gain infinite mana, then repeat the loop using Reality Spasm's other mode instead to tap down all opponents' permanents.
combos.title: Hinata, Dawn-Crowned + Soulfire Grand Master + Reality Spasm

description: **Core mechanic** : X-spells with multiple targets get a huge discount from Hinata (each target = {1} less) — a 5-target Comet Storm costs almost nothing.
**Enablers** : Battlefield Thaumaturge stacks another {1} discount per creature targeted; Elementalist's Palette charges mana for big X.
**Payoff** : Comet Storm, Jaya's Immolating Inferno, Release the Gremlins, Curse of the Swine, Open into Wonder and Launch the Fleet all shine.
win: **Lethal burn** : a giant Comet Storm or Jaya's Inferno with 4+ targets ends the game for a few mana.
**Mass removal** : Curse of the Swine with X targets exiles the whole board.
**Go-wide** : Launch the Fleet / Smoke Spirits' Aid turn X into an army.

text: **Spellslinger (606) and X Spells (539) are co-favorites**: 4 of the deck's cards sit in each plan's EDHREC High Synergy pool (Curse of the Swine, March of Swirling Mist, Comet Storm + Thaumaturge/Icy Blast) — the list is built exactly around Hinata's multi-target discount.

**The list is a budget spellslinger core**: 36 instants/sorceries (43% of nonland cards), 5 token engines (Young Pyromancer, Talrand, Murmuring Mystic, Deekah, Metallurgic Summonings) and 3 recursion engines (Feather, Radiant Scrollwielder, Mystic Retrieval) — the classic Jeskai storm-ish shell.

**Structural notes**: 22 lands (below the 36-38 target) but 13 ramp pieces (12 rocks + Myriad Landscape) compensate; only 3 dedicated draw spells but Whirlwind of Thought + token engines provide repeatable value; 11 interaction pieces with 5 counterspells — control plan viable.
**Biggest gap**: no commander protection (only March of Swirling Mist / Semester's End as one-shots) — Hinata removed = deck slows a lot; and the X-burn finishers need the commander alive.

summary: **Structure**: 22 lands · 13 ramp · 11 interaction · 10 engines · 23 flex · avg CMC 3.26 (nonland).
**Low-to-the-ground spellslinger**: cheap instants/sorceries (median 2) fuel the token engines.

**Gaps**: only 22 lands (target 36-38) — the curve is low but greedy X-spells need mana; no dedicated board wipes (Ondu Inversion is the only reset, as a land); draw is thin (3 dedicated spells) but Whirlwind of Thought + engines compensate.
